title: MV/MZ RPG Maker Overworld Map Generator. Free and Online.

posts.author: JardsonJean
posts.body:
Hi, everyone!
Lately, I mostly only been useing RPG Maker MV to create maps and it's always been a dream of me to create a tool to generate maps that I could use as a base and develop over them. The main challenge was figuring out how to interpret the JSON files that RPG Maker has and... I failed that challenge lol. But I did come up with an idea that's working pretty nice.
I created a simple custom marker tileset that you can import into your project replacing Tab C. You can download these directly in the
itch.io
page and import to your project (check the images below for visual guidance).
Here's how you use this tool:
Visit the page:
https://ladyluck.itch.io/rpg-maker-world-map-generator-online
Create your map and download the JSON file.
Copy and paste the JSON inside the data folder of your project (where your maps are).
Make sure you have a map with the same name inside your project.
(!!) Download and replace your World_C tileset with the custom tileset provided in the page. It will have markers showing you how to fill in the map.
Reload your project and use your autotiles on Tab A to fill the map.
Done!
Create your map, download both the JSON and the custom tileset provided in the page for Tab C and import both into your project.
Share this tool around and visit my page for more resources! Thanks!
ladyluck.itch.io
